SwapHero Sky Islands art reconstruction 0.3

Approved visual references, provided by the project owner:
https://app.notion.com/p/407e7ee349ad817ca64beaeb6318206d
Both preview PNGs were visually inspected. The discarded OriginalAssets composites are excluded.

Newly generated assets based on those previews:
assets/sky-islands/sky-camp.png — 1448x1086 RGB PNG, empty gathering-place scenery.
assets/sky-islands/sky-arena.png — 1448x1086 RGB PNG, empty four-terrace battleground.
assets/sky-islands/heroes-atlas.png — 1536x1024 RGBA PNG, six static character poses in a 3x2 atlas.
Character regions are rendered by CSS; sprite identity comes from src/art.mjs.
Generated art is a visual prototype. No frame animation sheet or original-game GIF is used.
The approved previews include World Flipper-inspired character cues. Generation does not establish an exclusive IP licence.
Unit names, stats, combat and formation rules remain placeholders from the existing engine.

Generation source recovery records:
https://app.notion.com/p/407e7ee349ad811d8656e67e0a15b1d3
